parameters.query: SELECT id, name, domain FROM global_companies WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY name

parameters.text:
=You are an executive database builder. From these news headlines about {{ $json.company_name }}, extract current executives mentioned.

Headlines:
{{ $json.headlines }}

Rules:
1. Extract anyone with these titles: CTO, VP of Engineering, VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, Head of DevOps, CISO, Chief Technology Officer, Chief Information Security Officer, Head of Infrastructure, Head of Platform, CMO, Chief Marketing Officer
2. Include current executives (e.g. "Figma CTO sells stock", "appointed", "joins as") — these imply the person currently holds the role
3. Skip anyone described as "former", "ex-", "previous", "steps down", "leaves", or "departed"
4. The person must be associated with {{ $json.company_name }} — ignore executives from other companies

Return a JSON array (no markdown, no explanation). If nothing found, return []
Format: [{"person_name": "...", "title": "...", "action": "current|joined|appointed", "source_title": "original headline", "pub_date": "..."}]

parameters.query: =SELECT CASE WHEN '{{ $json.person_name }}' = '' THEN 1 ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM executive_candidates_draft WHERE company_id = '{{ $json.company_id }}'::uuid AND person_name = '{{ $json.person_name }}' AND title = '{{ $json.title }}' UNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM executive_profiles WHERE company_id = '{{ $json.company_id }}'::uuid AND person_name = '{{ $json.person_name }}' AND title = '{{ $json.title }}') t) END as count

=INSERT INTO executive_candidates_draft (company_id, company_name, person_name, title, action, source_title, pub_date) VALUES ('{{ $('Parse AI to Candidates').item.json.company_id }}'::uuid, '{{ $('Parse AI to Candidates').item.json.company_name }}', '{{ $('Parse AI to Candidates').item.json.person_name }}', '{{ $('Parse AI to Candidates').item.json.title }}', '{{ $('Parse AI to Candidates').item.json.action }}', '{{ $('Parse AI to Candidates').item.json.source_title }}', '{{ $('Parse AI to Candidates').item.json.pub_date }}') ON CONFLICT (company_id, person_name, title) DO NOTHING
